chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
A patient is not healed with anything like honey.

key_terms.اسْتَشْفَى: to seek healing / to be healed

ai.seo_question: What is the medicinal benefit of honey according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) identifies honey as the superior medium for *istishfa* (seeking relief/healing), emphasizing its unique therapeutic potency in Shia medical tradition. This statement underscores the Prophetic practice of utilizing natural remedies, positioning honey not merely as food but as a divinely ordained medicinal agent for physical recovery.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A patient cannot be healed like (he can) with the likes of honey’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “
A patient does not receive a cure as he can with honey.’”
